evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search method (fingerprinting/content identification) and goal; no other story expresses the same requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Uses profile-based personalization, which is meaningfully different from other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Search based on other users (collaborative filtering-like) is distinct in context from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Query-by-example similarity including ringback tones is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-based discovery is a different mechanism and goal from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This is about upload/tag persistence for processing, distinct from discovery or prefiltering stories.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnail sequences is a unique UI/viewing requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Provides info about similar items; distinct story though a closely worded duplicate exists (ZO-009).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates ZO-008 (same actor and goal); 'perceptually' does not introduce a meaningful difference in actor, context, or goal.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation from similar profiles is different in context from active discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: News/event-based recommendation is a distinct recommendation signal and goal.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification and enrichment is a specific detection/enrichment requirement distinct from other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification differs in target entity from person/brand/logo identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection is a distinct requirement focused on broadcaster logos.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification targets a different category of entities than other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Query-by-image recommendation is distinct from other search/discovery requirements.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geographical map-based discovery is a distinct interaction/context requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct technique and requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is a unique maintenance/admin requirement.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotating news segments and topic extraction has a different goal than segmentation editing.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct admin requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Detecting edited audio is a specific quality-detection task different from general filtering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering for nudity is a specific content-safety filter distinct from other prefilter requirements.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: General low-level asset based prefiltering is a broad requirement distinct from more specific stories.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Automated copyright validation is a unique compliance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag-based prefiltering is meaningfully different from low-level prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Assessing interestingness using combined signals is a distinct analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Detecting scientist prompts is a distinct workflow/notification requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer typology classification is a distinct admin/analytics requirement.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification for Galaxy Zoo is a specialized requirement distinct from general prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Snapshot Serengeti-specific detection is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Timestamp-series detection is a different technical requirement from other image tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is a distinct classification task specific to the project.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., attributes beyond species) is materially different from species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Detecting number of animals is a different analytic output from other Snapshot Serengeti tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is a project-specific computer vision requirement distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific empty-class detection differs from other prefiltering tasks by target and context.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a distinct analysis requirement for Plankton Portal.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Plankton Portal is a distinct project task.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis for video reduction is a unique processing goal specific to Worm Watch Lab.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a distinct detection task from motion-analysis/video reduction.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Satellite image feature detection is a unique domain-specific requirement.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-weighted classification scoring is a distinct analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: This is a specific instance of low-level asset-based prefiltering already expressed by ZO-024 (same actor and goal), so it is substantially contained.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a specific detection capability distinct from other tasks.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a specific processing requirement distinct from other audio/image tasks.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping whale calls is a domain-specific clustering requirement distinct from other grouping stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a distinct analytic requirement from grouping or detection.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing interruption is a different requirement from selecting interruption medium or education tasks.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: This concerns the medium of interruption (distinct from when to interrupt), so it is not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing education is a different goal and workflow than interruption or content selection.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education medium differs from general education timing and from interruption medium.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the specific educational content is a distinct requirement from timing or medium decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is a specific monitoring requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Timing for Zoonibot commenting is distinct from explanation timing or content generation requirements.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Determining when to provide explanations is a different conditional-action requirement than commenting.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Content-generation for Zoonibot is a distinct requirement from timing or decision tasks.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: General subject grouping is a distinct capability and not a duplicate of specific grouping stories.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is a different recommendation target and context than content recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a unique admin/content requirement not duplicated elsewhere.
